name: Firework cake or barrage
definition: multi-tube firework fired from a single fuse, a compound cake included, set on the ground.
notes: Cakes & Barrages is one shop category; split from Firework (GR_S12).

name: Firework rocket
definition: firework on a stick that climbs and bursts in the air.
notes: Rockets own category at both shops.

name: Firework fountain
definition: firework that stands on the ground and throws up a spray of sparks.
notes: Fountains own category (Dynamic pairs with mines).

name: Roman candle
definition: firework tube that fires a series of stars or balls one after another.
notes: Roman Candles own category at both shops.

name: Catherine wheel
definition: firework fixed to a post that spins as it burns, throwing sparks.
notes: Catherine wheels own category at both shops.

name: Haze machine
definition: machine that makes a fine even haze so light beams show, not a dense fog.
notes: Hazers a separate sub-category from Smoke Machines at Thomann.
